## VerifyMaker type

The `v` a relation's `verify` receives: `v(loader, decide)` makes the verification, its loader  keyed by the relation's `to` and its rule typed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type VerifyMaker<E extends Entities, T extends keyof E & string, L extends Attrs> = <V, LN extends Attrs, CP, LH extends Attrs>(loader: Loader<T, KeyOf<E, T>, V, LN, CP, LH>, decide: (candidates: readonly Candidate<LinkOut<KeyOf<E, T>, L, CarriedOf<E, T>>, V>[]) => readonly Verdict[]) => VerificationDef;
```
